source_or_rationale: Small-satellite comparison preserving the saved initial root (-3,0.2,0.15), baseline dry mass, fuel, single-nozzle thrust and burn law. Original visual geometry is uniformly scaled; inertia is an explicit uniform bus-box approximation with COM at the source origin. These are not flight dimensions, masses or propulsion calibration.

desdyni.mass_definition: dry mass before ThrustAction adds remaining fuel
desdyni.inertia_model: uniform bus bounding-box approximation; appendage mass distribution and tank geometry are not modeled

near_shoemaker.inertia_model: uniform central-bus box approximation; no powered target actuators
